key_insight: Dr. OPD learns which teacher token-level signals matter most, then weights them to maximize student performance instead of treating all supervision equally.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical way to make on-policy distillation more efficient and effective for deploying smaller LLMs in math and code tasks.
method: Formulate optimal on-policy distillation as a bilevel optimization problem.
Alternate between closed-form token-weight updates and one gradient step on the weighted student objective.
Use learned weights to emphasize teacher supervision that most improves expected reward.
evidence_signal: Across strong-to-weak and same-size distillation on math and code, Dr. OPD outperformed all baselines and improved average math performance by 9.7 points over vanilla OPD.
watch_item: The approach adds bilevel/iterative optimization complexity, so stable weight updates and compute overhead may be important in practice.
paper_title: Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
